label: Tournament Access
description: Closes a tournament server to everyone not on the tournament roster. The tournament hub writes the roster (players and casters) into the server's Redis; when the hub marks it enforced, players not on it are kicked as they load, casters are kept in spectator, and on a lobby server everyone stays in spectator. The server owner and players at the bypass permission level are never checked.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the roster check on. It also needs a Tournament ID, and the hub must mark the roster as enforced.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: Hub tournament whose roster this server uses. 0 turns the check off.

cvars.label: Bypass Permission
cvars.description: Players with at least this minqlx permission level skip the roster check.

cvars.label: Dev Auth Open
cvars.description: Turns the roster check off entirely, for testing. Leave it off on a real tournament.
